messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts for tenant 'Crow Analytics' on dedicated cluster ded-crow-01. Error rate spike detected at 5955551220. Paging oncall.

alyssa: paging @ravi (oncall) — customer reports ~30% 5xx on production endpoints, started ~10m ago. UI teams seeing timeouts.

ravi (oncall): on it. pulling logs and metrics now. any idea if this is KV/cache or gpu saturation?

elena_ops: seeing sustained queue depth increase on ded-crow-01 for renderer-workers. KV evictions jump at 5955551205, plus GPU util at 97% on node g3-09.

samir_infra: confirmed. KV p99 latencies ~450ms, evictions spike. Also noticing repeated `OOM` logs on a replica set for the batch-prep service. Possible noisy tenant job.

ravi (oncall): ok quick triage:
```
# top-level checks
kubectl -n ded-crow get pods --selector=pool=ded-crow-01 -o wide
kubectl -n ded-crow logs deploy/batch-prep --since=15m | tail -n 50
```
logs show `evicting KV entry` and `connection reset by peer` repeated.

michael_prodeng: customer SRE on Crow said they kicked off a large historical reindex around 09:10 UTC — may be high-cost batch hitting the cluster.

jane_sre_customer: yes that job started ~09:05 and was supposed to be low-priority. It crawls a lot of long-context requests. We can pause if needed.

ravi (oncall): we have two immediate mitigations: 1) throttle/rate-limit the reindex job from Crow, 2) shift some Crow traffic to a lower-priority pool or degraded-model fallback to reduce memory/KV pressure. Which is preferable?

alyssa: customer consent needed for pausing? jane_sre_customer can we pause the job? If they approve, do it now. Otherwise we should apply routing throttle.

jane_sre_customer: pausing now — stopping reindex job. Standby.

incident-bot: ACTION: customer job pause recorded at 5955551240 by jane_sre_customer.

elena_ops: pausing reduced ingress by ~40% but KV eviction still elevated; GPUs still near-saturated due to in-flight requests. We should evict noisy pods and add capacity.

samir_infra: I can spin up 2 spare GPU nodes in the pool with infra playbook:
```
infra playbook run add-gpu --pool ded-crow-01 --count 2 --type g4dn.xlarge
```
Will take ~7-10m to bootstrap. Need approval to proceed.

ravi (oncall): proceed with playbook. Also apply short-term routing throttle to Crow to cap concurrency to 60% of usual while nodes spin up. Add a canary rule to keep control.

alyssa: +1. annotate change and contact support line to warn of degraded latencies.

elena_ops: applying routing change now:
```
# routing config snippet
route.modify --pool ded-crow-01 --tenant crow-analytics --concurrency-cap 0.6 --reason "noisy-job mitigation"
```
deploy-bot: routing change applied by elena_ops at 5955551252. Canary: 5% traffic to fallback pool.

ravi (oncall): monitoring p50/p95/p99 and 5xx after throttle.

incident-bot: metric link: https://metrics.internal/redwood/dedicated/ded-crow-01?from=5955551180&to=5955551280 (placeholder)

elena_ops: infra playbook started at 5955551258 (samir_infra). Nodes expected ready ~5955551318.

samir_infra: nodes up and kube join completed at 5955551325. Pods are draining onto new capacity. Preliminary GPU util dropping to 72%. KV evictions decreasing.

ravi (oncall): 5xx rate went from 30% to 6% after routing cap + capacity, timeouts reduced. Still monitoring for residual errors.

jane_sre_customer: Crow confirms error rate decreased on their side. They saw some retries but core flows recovered. Thank you.

michael_prodeng: record interim customer impact: ~20 minutes effective impact window (09:05-09:25ish), approx 30% failures initially, partial customer retry mitigation reduced visible errors.

alyssa: nice work. we should schedule a short postmortem and CAPT (customer advisory) note. I’ll open a follow-up.

ravi (oncall): handing off to next oncall @elena_ops for cleanup and postmortem artifacts. I documented timeline and actions.

elena_ops: taking handoff. Will collect logs, attach playbook run output, and create incident ticket. Tentative sev2.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: from ravi (oncall) to elena_ops at 5955551330.

samir_infra: follow-up action: add autoscale alert for KV eviction > 100/s and GPU util > 90% sustained for 2m. I'll file infra ticket.

alyssa: assign postmortem to eng-runtime and eng-infra to determine improved throttling/routing defaults for long-running batch jobs.

jane_sre_customer: will coordinate with Crow to avoid running heavy historical reindexes on production pools; they will use staging or schedule during off-peak.

ravi (oncall): closing active pager. Will remain available if regressions. Great cross-team response. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED at 5955551345. Summary: noisy customer batch job -> KV evictions + GPU saturation -> routing throttle + capacity bump -> resolved.
